dense, impervious, BhP. viii, 3, 5
(गम्भ्˚, R. iii)
not to be penetrated or investigated or explored, inscrutable

a: गभीर — a. [गच्छति जलमत्र, गम् ईरन् भांतादेशश्च Uṇ. 4. 35] 1 Deep (in all senses); उ त्तालास्त इमे गभीरपयसः पुण्याः सरित्संगमाः U. 2. 30; Bv. 2. 105. --2 Deepsounding (as a drum). --3 Thick, dense, impervious (as a forest). --4 Profound, sagacious. --5 Grave, serious, solemn, earnest. --6 Secret, mysterious. --7 Inscrutable, difficult to be perceived or understood. --Comp. --आत्मन् the Supreme Soul. --वेध a. very penetrating.
